titles: ML vs Generative AI: Wouri Express
youtube.description:
At Wouri Express, Mbella needs two different kinds of AI to answer her questions. Learn how machine learning predicts outcomes based on past data while generative AI creates new content.

Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
